name: @openagt/github-auto-reply
description: The reply command for coding agents: an agent whose pull request got a maintainer's comment, a red check or a conflict after it ended is woken on its own conversation to answer it. Its skill, the plugin module that gives it to runs, and the command its scheduler row checks GitHub with.

scripts.prepack: node -e "if(!process.env.npm_config_user_agent?.startsWith('pnpm/')){console.error('Pack and publish with pnpm: it replaces workspace:* with the real version, npm does not');process.exit(1)}"
